content.text:
The campaign ran Jan 6–8, 2027 (Dhaka time) and has ended. It spent **$639.78 of the $650.00 budget**, but it did not track trial starts, which was the goal.

**What I launched**
- One campaign, "Jovunara NY Free Trial - Jan 6-8 2027," with three ad groups, one per approved post. Each had a $216 total cap and a $72 daily cap, so the total stayed under $650.
- Each ad group targeted iOS only and excluded China, matching your app and landing-page terms.
- Schedule: 00:00 Jan 6 to 00:00 Jan 9, Asia/Dhaka.
- No new copy was written. I did not make any mid-flight changes.

**Results (from X's reporting)**

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Cost per link click |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2138696687416686580 (laptop) | $212.30 | 417,570 | 309 | $0.69 |
| 2138877881350341546 (nine-minute routines) | $214.48 | 300,022 | 367 | $0.58 |
| 2139059075284323251 (resolution starting date) | $212.99 | 399,306 | 343 | $0.62 |
| **Total** | **$639.78** | **1,116,898** | **1,019** | |

**What the reporting does and doesn't show**
- **Trial starts: unknown.** X has no pixel on your site, so it cannot see trial starts. The campaign was optimized for link clicks, the closest signal available. Clicks are not trial starts.
- **Billing looks inconsistent.** The line items were set to bill per link click, but the billing data shows far more billed engagements than clicks (for example, 2,910 billed engagements for 309 link clicks on the first post). Please check the invoice to see what you were actually charged.
- **Copy was English only.** The three approved posts are all in English. I found no versions in other languages, so the non-English markets you mentioned did not see localized ads. If you have localized posts, send them and I can run a follow-up campaign with them.

**Recommendations**
1. Install the X pixel on the site, and set the trial-start event as the conversion. Without it, the next campaign cannot be optimized for the outcome you care about.
2. If you want the cheapest clicks, the nine-minute post performed best on cost per click. It is only one flight's data, so treat that as a lead, not a conclusion.
